about: Index of the Project spec, read by scripts/spec-check.py and the session start hook.
BRD.md, PRD.md, FRD.md and TRD.md are the authority; this file follows them and is kept by hand.
status is current or removed. An FR takes the priority and phase of its first PR.
An FR's tests are the test methods or @DisplayName values that carry its ID.

br.title: A client creates a website from a template in one step, within the plan's website limit
Two saves of one website never silently overwrite each other
A generation request freezes the pages, is counted once by Payment and reaches AI Codegen
Accepted code is committed to the site's Gitea repository and Provisioning can deploy it
Each website has a fixed visitor-facing name that is never reused
Other services learn reliably who owns a website and what changed
A deleted website goes offline, its catalog is archived and its plan slot is freed
Only the owner sees or changes a website; anyone else is told it does not exist
A deleted or suspended website stays readable to its owner but cannot be changed
Nothing is purged: websites and requests stay forever; pages are only marked deleted
Payment alone decides plan limits; Project refuses when Payment cannot answer
The databases match the Notion design exactly, nothing more
Sign-in is checked at the gateway, then by Project; only the user ID travels between services
Payment, AI Codegen, Keycloak and the mesh are built by others; stand-ins run only in prototype
Every dependency is open source, at least 14 days old and pinned

pr.title: Picks a business type and template and creates the website in one step, if the plan allows; retry-safe
Chooses the website's sub-domain at creation; it never changes and is never reused
Sees and renames their own websites; a deleted or suspended one is read-only
Adds, edits, reorders and deletes pages, up to the page limit, without losing a save
Loads the builder's component catalog
Freezes a generation contract for chosen product types
Asks to generate, one request at a time, safe to retry, and sees its status and failure reason
Gets a Git repository for the site and the code committed safely
Gets tested code from AI Codegen accepted and published
Deletes a website
Finds a website by its sub-domain (exact or prefix)
Provisioning asks over REST whether a user may act on a project
Provisioning, portals and the auth library ask over gRPC `CheckAccess`; the REST check then goes
A website portal checks that the signed-in user owns the site (`manage_site`)
Payment is asked before each new website, and an unused admission is released
AI Codegen hears that a request was admitted and reads its frozen input
Catalog gets every new website registered in the background
Provisioning finds a site's repository and sub-domain over gRPC `GetRepository` (no REST version)
Provisioning, Payment and Notification hear "source published"
Provisioning and Payment hear "project deleted"
Provisioning hears when a website owner is suspended or active again
AI Codegen and Notification ask Project over gRPC: input, scaffold, thread owner, project owner
Operators: a token is checked at the gateway and by Project; inner calls carry only the user ID
Operators: the next migration brings the database level with Notion

tr.title: One deployable: API, gRPC server, listeners, outbox relay and jobs in one process
Features are folders inside each layer, not Modulith modules; common uses no feature
Four layers per feature with fixed dependency directions (ArchUnit)
Type and feature folders per layer (TYPE_FOLDERS), generated stubs used only in presentation/grpc
Layer-first Java tree of Notion 6.1; request, response and validation per feature in application
Repositories in infrastructure/persistence used directly by the feature's services; not CQRS
Fixed stack and the dependency rule (14 days, pinned, locked, verified, OSV clean)
Spring Data JPA on Hibernate with ddl-auto validate, PostgreSQL 18, Flyway
Spring AMQP with the Namastack outbox through Modulith externalization
gRPC with grpc-java and protobuf; stubs generated in their own contracts source set
Contracts pinned by full SHA in contracts.lock and copied only by scripts/contracts-sync.sh
Gradle check gates and report-only PMD, CPD and SpotBugs
Guard commit ID check covers src/main, src/test, build.gradle, gradle and scripts
Both databases equal Notion S1 and S3 including column position; zero audit differences
Database roles and grants as Notion lists them
Forward-only Flyway migrations; production migrates only in the separate job
Migration V6: rebuild projects in Notion order with subdomain; drop domains; owner index; grants
Frozen columns guarded by triggers; constraint names mapped to error codes per feature
Edit revision, one request in flight and bounded statement and lock waits
Change and event or job in one transaction; inbox records handled messages once
Catalog reached through its own pool as catalog_platform; pending registrations
REST /api/v1 formats: camelCase, envelope, Problem Details, cursor paging
Internal REST endpoints for access checks and codegen input
One gRPC server on port 9090: own services only, bounded sizes, calls in flight and connections
gRPC statuses with ErrorInfo, BadRequest; read-only FAILED_PRECONDITION; unknown method answer
CheckAccess maps to the same request record, rules and AccessCheckService as REST
AccessAction equals the shared action list in the pinned contracts
Events on the project.events topic exchange with the snake_case envelope
Outgoing HTTP only from integration modules, bounded, carrying the user ID, never a token
Token checked again on /api: RS256, issuer, audience project, typ, exp, nbf, user_id
Internal REST and gRPC take no token; mTLS and the mesh policy are the gate
Not the owner is 404; the access check answers NOT_FOUND or NOT_MANAGER; no method security
No token, body, personal data or failing row detail in logs or errors
Exactly one profile; stand-ins only in prototype; production refuses test settings
Every database wait and outgoing call is bounded; gRPC callers fail closed
Health, metrics and request IDs on every request, log line and gRPC error
Durable jobs retry on schedule; delivery at least once; no answer is never yes
One image with ports 8080, 9090 and 8081; manifests and mesh policies outside the repo
Migration job before each rollout; the previous version stops before V6
Prototype-only OpenAPI description and Swagger UI for /api/v1; never /internal
